name: UNSW Sydney
summary: Sydney's Kensington campus; three terms a year, over 400 degree and double-degree options and more than 20 engineering disciplines.

ib.text: The 2027 international table gives each degree an IB total: Arts 29, Science 29, Engineering 35, Commerce 36, Law 36, Medical Studies/MD 40. It is a guide only; actual requirements may be higher or lower.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: A four-year honours engineering degree across more than 20 engineering disciplines, with a flexible first year, project-based learning and industry training.
programmes.ib: 2027 table guide: 35 IB points. Check the degree page for subject prerequisites.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total against the 2027 guide; actual requirements may be higher or lower.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Engineering (Hons): over 20 engineering disciplines, flexible first year, industry training

programmes.name: Bachelor of Commerce
programmes.about: UNSW Business School's core undergraduate degree, built around problem-solving and business for a sustainable society, with majors and double degrees to combine it with other fields.
programmes.ib: 2027 table guide: 36 IB points; Commerce (International) 38 and Actuarial Studies 41.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total against the 2027 guide; actual requirements may be higher or lower.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Commerce at UNSW Business School: problem-solving for business success and a sustainable society

faculties.name: Arts, Design and Architecture
faculties.line: Arts 29 IB points; Architectural Studies 33; Design 29.

faculties.name: Business School
faculties.line: Commerce 36 IB points, Economics 33, Actuarial Studies 41.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Engineering (Hons) 35 IB points; Advanced Computer Science 36 and Science (Computer Science) 34.

faculties.name: Medicine and Health
faculties.line: Medical Studies/MD 40 IB points; Vision Science 33. Medicine adds eligibility checks by the faculty.

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Science 29 IB points, Medical Science 33, Advanced Mathematics (Hons) 34.

notes: UNSW says international students taking the IB Diploma apply for undergraduate courses through UAC; other international applicants apply in the UNSW Applicant Portal.
UNSW runs three terms a year, and not every program has a Term 2 or Term 3 intake.
From 2028 UNSW moves to a flex-semester calendar, so the length of your degree may vary depending on when you start.
